body:
Thank you all for attending the meeting today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11146):

### Agenda  
Attendees:  Luke Warlow, Michael Smith, Emilio Cobos Álvarez, Olli Pettay, Simon Pieters  
Scribe: 

1. Review past action items
    1.  Olli and Anne will take a look at [ARIA notify iframe restrictions](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11004).
        1. [smaug] not done
    1. Chris will talk to the CSSWG about [native/primitive appearance of Customizable `<select>`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11107).
    1. Olli will take a look at the selection PR for [Should live range expose endpoints inside a shadow tree](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1362).
        1. [smaug] Did take a look at the [selection pr 345](https://github.com/w3c/selection-api/pull/345)
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Di] [Naming of Composed Range](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1363)
    1. [Dom] [FACE reset algorithm during custom element creation](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/11122)
    1. [smaug] Should we try (again) to remove XSLT?
        1. Some usage numbers: [XSLTProcessor](https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/timeline/popularity/79), [XSLProcessingInstruction](https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/timeline/popularity/78)
    1. [Luke] [Update dialog to minimally handle open attribute mutations](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10954)
        1. Olli will review.
    1. [Luke] [https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11130](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11130)
1. New topics
    1. [Emilio/Henrik] [Clarify correct behavior for requestAnimationFrame for hidden iframes (display: none)](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11138)

### Action Items

1.  @smaug---- will review the [Update dialog to minimally handle open attribute mutations](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10954).

### Minutes
